name: Jamaica
summary: An English invasion creates a lasting colonial possession.
notes: Maroon communities resisted colonial control and secured treaties in 1739–1740. Neither conquest nor treaty meant uniform control of the island.

events.title: Spain claims Jamaica
events.detail: Columbus landed and claimed the island for the Spanish monarchs.
events.qualification: A European claim; it does not establish island-wide administration or extinguish Indigenous rights.

events.title: Spanish settlers arrive
events.detail: Juan de Esquivel led the first Spanish colonists.
events.uncertainty: Some chronologies use 1510; the Jamaican government dates the settlement to 1509.

events.title: England invades Jamaica
events.detail: The failed English expedition against Hispaniola turned to Jamaica and took the Spanish colony.

events.title: Spain recognizes English possession
events.detail: The Treaty of Madrid confirmed England’s hold on Jamaica.

events.title: Maroon autonomy recognized
events.detail: Treaties following the First Maroon War recognized communities beyond ordinary plantation control.

events.title: Jamaica becomes independent
events.detail: Self-government and the collapse of the West Indies Federation preceded independence.
